title: Generating MOS scales
description: Many equal temperaments lack an interval near a just 3/2, but still contain many useful scales constructed by stacking one generating interval.

title: MOS nominals and roots
description: Moment of symmetry scales consist of large (L) and small (s) steps mixed as evenly as possible. They use nominals from J onwards and J is always aligned with the root frequency.

title: Modes and UDP notation
description: Modes are selected by specifying an explicit pattern or by using UDP notation.

props.source:
# "Lorkhanic" of "Smitonic"
MOS{LsLsLLs}
J K L M N O P j=

# "Kagrenacan" of "Smitonic"
# Measuring from the root J...
# two scale degrees are bright (i.e. wide),
# while four degrees are dark (i.e. narrow)
MOS{4L 3s 2|4}
J K L M N O P j=

title: Scale hardness
description: The ratio between the sizes of L and s steps is called hardness. It defaults to 2:1 i.e. "basic" hardness. You can either provide the scale pattern in terms of small integers or by specifying L:s after the fact.

title: Complex step ratios
description: More complex step ratios require commas between the steps.

title: Multi-period scales
description: MOS scales that have multiple identical periods per octave have less modes available.

title: MOS accidentals
description: Ampersand & (read "am") raises by one chroma (L - s), while at-sign @ (read "at") lowers by one chroma.

props.source:
MOS{2L 5s}
J J& K L M N@ N O P j=

MOS{2L 5s 3:1}
J Je J& K L M N@ Na N O P j=

title: MOS ups and downs
description: Diamond-mos pitches get their own ups and downs from the underlying equal temperament.

props.source:
# Minihard Trial implying 17edo
# L = 7\17
# s = 3\17
# & = L-s = 4\17
# e = &/2 = 2\17
# ^ = 1\17 (always one step)
# / = 5\17 (always five steps)
MOS{2L 1s 7:3}
J ^J Je ^Je J& /J vK K

title: Unreduced hardness
description: Hardness declarations are not reduced. 8:4 implies basic hardness but finer octave division.

title: Custom MOS ups and lifts
description: MOS ups and lifts are customizable. Integers are interpreted as steps of the host edo.

props.editorLabel: Custom MOS ups and lifts source

title: Other MOS equaves
description: MOS equave is set by enclosing it in angle brackets.

props.source:
# 9edf is acceptable for Carlos Alpha
# "Dionian" of hard "Saturnian"
MOS{2L3s<3/2> 2|2 3:1}
J K L M N j=

title: Modulating a MOS scale
description: You can move the same MOS mode to a different key...

props.source:
# "Erev" of "Machinoid"
MOS{5L 1s}
J K L M N O j=

# Same scale but 4\11 higher
# J becomes J& and K becomes K&
MOS{key = L}
L M N O j k l=

title: Changing MOS modes
description: ...or specify a new UDP mode altogether.

props.source:
# "Medicinal" of "Manual"
MOS{4L 1s 3|1}
J K L M N j=

# Switch to "Indical" mode on K
# M becomes M@
MOS{key = K 1|3}
K L M N j k=

title: Custom MOS key signatures
description: Custom key signatures are supported. A natural sign restores the unaltered nominal.

title: Large MOS scales
description: When the system runs out of nominals it starts over but prefixes everything with a J.

title: Just intonation MOS scales
description: MOS scales tuned to just intonation have irrational hardness so you have to define the size of a step directly.
